ops.body:
Tiering policy (decided 2026-07-19, extended 2026-08-01): the **core record kinds** agents route work to are task, note, doc, log, papercut, runbook, investigation, plan. **Sprint/project are the planning layer** — they stay out of one-line nudges and the record router by design; SKILL.md presents them as the optional layer. A surface may curate its *presentation*, never its *kind universe*.

A new kind (or record noun) isn't done at the Go layer. It lands in EVERY surface below in the same change:

## Prose surfaces
- `README.md` — commands-table row; a use case for headline kinds; the MCP paragraph's tool examples. It states the kind count in prose more than once; grep the numeral, no test guards it.
- `.claude/fragments/AGENTS.md/cc-notes-development-guide.fragment.md` — Repository Structure annotations (`model/`, `internal/cli`). AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md are GENERATED: render with the cc-guides version pinned in `.claude/fragments/cc-guides.lock` (release binary, not a dev build) and commit fragments + artifacts together.
- cc-skills `plugin/guides/md/claude-rules.md` § Durable Records (renders into every fleet repo's CLAUDE.md) — add the routing clause, push cc-skills@main, re-render consumers.
- `plugin/skills/using-cc-notes/SKILL.md` — tools table, canonical flow, cheat-sheet; `references/cli-reference.md` (full per-kind section, guarded both directions by TestMCPReferenceMatchesRegistry); `references/tasks-vs-notes.md` (the N-way count); `references/lifecycle-and-hygiene.md` (which lifecycle bucket the kind joins).

## Hook/nudge surfaces (plugin/capt-hook/hooks/)
- `session.py` `announce_cc_notes_available` — BOTH wording variants; the assertion in `tests/test_cc_notes.py` ("announce fires: names the durable tooling") pins the fallback line verbatim.
- `record.py` `RECORD_ROUTER_SYSTEM` + a routing branch; `common.py` `RECORD_KINDS` only if the kind uses the generic `record_command()` path (runbook/investigation/plan precedent: dedicated branches instead).
- `redirect.py` `CC_NOTES_TOOLS`; `workflow.py` `CC_NOTES_WRITE_VERBS` + `MCP_READ_TOOLS`. `tests/test_cc_notes.py` asserts a hardcoded `len(CC_NOTES_TOOLS)` — it goes red on any tool addition.
- `plugin/capt-hook/hooks/README.md` — teach table, record-router table, framework primitive list.
- `approval.py` — if the new surface reads/writes filesystem paths or executes anything, extend the DANGEROUS_* carve-outs (see doc 7b4a1647). A flag that reads an arbitrary path (`--body-file`) belongs in DANGEROUS_CLI_FLAGS or an auto-approved call can read any file on disk.
- Test gate: `uv run plugin/capt-hook/hooks/tests/test_cc_notes.py` (the SCRIPT form, which is what ci.yml runs). `uv run pytest` on that file is NOT a gate — `check()` only appends to a module-level FAILURES list and `main()` is what exits non-zero, so pytest reports all-passed with a live regression present.

## Binary/manifest surfaces
- `internal/mcpserver/instructions.go` — no byte cap as of 2026-08-01. The former 2KB "clients truncate" cap was removed after review found no in-repo evidence for the client behavior it claimed to mirror; it had been forcing real guidance out to make room.
- `plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` + `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` descriptions; bump the plugin version.
- `web/src/kinds.ts` — the EntityKind union, WIRE_KINDS (must match Go's codec order exactly), DISPLAY_KINDS, MARKER_KINDS. **Nothing ties this TS list to Go's `model.Kinds()`**, so it drifts silently. Also `web/src/api.ts` (a Snapshot interface + the union), `browse/index.ts`, `detail/Snapshot.tsx`, `App.tsx`, `theme.css` badge, and `api.test.ts`'s hand-enumerated null bucket.
- `internal/cli/root.go` package doc **and its hardcoded AddCommand call-list** (miss it and the whole noun silently does not exist), `internal/refs` roots map, a fold folder, `internal/mcpserver/tools_<kind>.go` + the hardcoded `registerAll` list (parity tests guard both directions).

## Silent-miss surfaces — no panic, no failing test, just a quiet gap
Added 2026-08-01 from the `plan` rollout; each was found by adversarial review, not by the build.
- `notes/relevant.go` — `id()` and `updatedAt()` have a `default:` returning the **zero Note's** fields, so an unlisted kind ranks on a zero id and zero timestamp. `entryVerdict`'s `default:` routes to `verdictOf(freshFromNote(zero Note))`, whose `VerifiedAt == 0` rule renders the kind permanently **UNVERIFIED** — a work-shaped kind must join the explicit empty-verdict arm.
- `internal/lifecycle/lifecycle.go` — **TWO** kind switches, both silent: `Classify` (`default: return nil`; miss it and the kind generates zero timeline events, absent from both the viz swimlane and the kg session graph) and `Branch` (`default: return ""`; a branch-anchored record sits off-swimlane).
- `internal/store/gc.go` — `PruneTombstones` is hand-copied per kind, and `liveTips` was hardcoded, so `GCLocal` evicted the fold-cache entry of every kind missing from it. It was already broken for sprint, project and runbook. Now collapsed onto `model.Kinds()`; keep it that way and keep `TestGCLocalKeepsEveryKindsLiveEntry` green.
- `internal/store/dedupe.go` — `dupCheckers` row, plus any comparator that must learn a new task field (`sameTaskContent`, `dedupeCovered`). No compiler or test tripwire for the latter two.
- `internal/cli/search.go` `searchAllKinds` and `notes/relevant.go` `Relevant()` — hand-enumerated blocks; omission is silent. Sprint and project are still absent from `searchAllKinds` today.
- `notes/status.go` — `sumSkipped` must include the kind; the `SkippedOps` godoc says every kind contributes.
- `internal/kg/eval/corpus.go` `LoadCorpus`, and `internal/kg/stale` decay half-lives.
- `internal/kg/build.go` `newRecord` — this one PANICS (`default:`), and `Build` finds records by wildcard walk over `refs.Namespace`, so the first ref of an unregistered kind crashes `cc-notes kg` outright. Also add the record-struct field + `entityEdge` if the kind carries a pointer.
- `internal/fusefs` — **three** registries, not two: `codecs`, `layouts`, and the **authority catalog** (`authority.go` mints a `kind:<k>` source object per `model.Kinds()`). The first two have exhaustiveness tests; the authority catalog surfaces as ~9 failing tests. A read-only codec wires only `render`, so `readOnly: true` is load-bearing — flipping it routes writes into a nil `parse` func, i.e. a panic inside the signed helper daemon.
- Fold: `planFolder.apply`-style folders **must chain the shared `bundles.go` helpers BEFORE their type switch**. Skipping that makes every anchor/label/comment/supersede op on the kind a skipped op under tolerant fold and a hard `ErrKindMismatch` under strict — the exact shape of the bug commit 5733259 fixed.
- Born status rides on the create op, never as a second op in the create pack: `internal/store/write.go` `create` returns `*DuplicateError{Existing}` and **discards the ops** on a dedupe hit, so a second op vanishes silently.

Precedent: the 2026-07 sweep that synced all of the above to the 8-kind model (investigation was absent from README/AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/session.py five weeks after sprint/project shipped and two days after investigation did), and the 2026-08-01 `plan` rollout, where the loud surfaces were caught by the build in minutes and every surface in the silent list above was caught only by adversarial review.
